name: Memories ~Natsuiro no Kioku~
source:
Parents go on a year long overseas business trip while main character stays to take care of his two sisters. And little by little desires of forbidden love awaken.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母去海外出差一年，主人公留下来照顾两个妹妹。背德之爱的欲望一点点地觉醒了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
